summary: Read and reply to letters from Hermes.
page_description: Read and reply to letters from your own Hermes Agent. The inbox and your drafts stay readable offline, and replies are sent when the gateway is back.
release_notes: Read complete letters with fixed page and reply controls, including delivery notices. Inbox rows use measured display pages independently of gateway batches. Setup keeps the login instructions visible at large text sizes.

steps.text: Deploy a compatible Hermes gateway behind HTTPS and note its public URL.
Install the gateway bearer token under the exact name hermes-post.
